admin.loginLead: Log in with the organizer email and password.

qcm.title: Induction quiz
qcm.lead: Open the session here, then watch each candidate: their full screen, camera, current question, and score.
qcm.inviteLead: Each email below is one examinee. They receive a personal appointment for “{{title}}”, with the exam date.
qcm.appointmentHint: This date is emailed to each candidate. Their personal link stays valid until they finish the exam, not only at that hour.
qcm.inviteHint: This email sends the appointment and the personal link for “{{title}}”. The examinee must log in with that same address.
qcm.inviteNeedEmails: Add at least one email address.
qcm.inviteNeedDate: Choose the exam date and time.
qcm.noInvites: Nobody has received a link for this quiz yet.
qcm.archiveConfirm: Archive this session? The same people can be invited again on this quiz. History stays until you delete it.
qcm.archiveDone: Session archived. You can invite the same emails again.
qcm.archiveEmpty: There is nothing to archive yet.
qcm.archivesHint: An archive keeps the sittings and invites. Delete it only when you no longer need it.
qcm.question: Question
qcm.needQuestions: Add questions first, then open the session.
qcm.editorLead: Write the title and questions in French. English is translated automatically when you save. Tick the correct answer. You can edit while the session is closed.
qcm.timerHint: Leave blank for no limit. You can set one, the other, or both.
qcm.locked: The session is open, or a candidate is still taking it. Close it before editing questions.
qcm.passTooHigh: The pass mark cannot be higher than the number of questions.
qcm.cameraWait: Allow the camera and microphone so candidates can see you.
qcm.cameraDenied: Camera or microphone was blocked. Candidates will not see or hear you.
qcm.callEnded: Call ended. Restart it to see candidates again.
qcm.scoresSent: Scores emailed. Candidate screens are now off.
qcm.noScores: There are no candidate scores to send.

errors.apiDown: The API is not reachable. Restart the backend server, then try again.
errors.invalidForm: Check the title, the prompts, and at least two answers per question.

pwa.installText: Add the monitoring room to your home screen so it fits like an app on your phone.
pwa.installIos: On iPhone, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
